study type: secondary analysis of a multicenter prospective cohort study
exposure: screening positive for depression at baseline
history of a prior cesarean delivery
outcome: discordance between expected and experienced pain
cohort: The study included 644 participants undergoing medication or procedural abortion up to 11 weeks 6 days gestation.
finding: Medication abortion, history of severe menstrual pain, and baseline depression were strongly associated with participant-reported severe postabortion pain and heavy bleeding.
mod_finding: Medication abortion was strongly associated with severe pain and heavy bleeding, and abortion method was a significant predictor of discordance between bleeding expectations and experience.
